Usage: tar [OPTION...] [FILE]...
Synthetic sample in GNU argp format.

 Main operation mode:
  -c, --create               new archive
  -t, --list                 list contents
  -x, --extract, --get       extract
 Compression options:
  -z, --gzip, --gunzip, --ungzip   gzip filter
  -f, --file=ARCHIVE         archive file
  -C, --directory=DIR        change to DIR
      --exclude=PATTERN      skip PATTERN
